text:
Upon entering, the counter staff were unresponsive and didn't greet me with a greeting until I reached the counter. They then inquired about my medical history, and I requested additional documents for reimbursement, which they acknowledged.

I then confirmed my social security insurance for teeth cleaning, which I had booked online for a promotional price of ฿1,100.

When I went upstairs to the second floor, the assistant called out to me, but didn't use my name, causing confusion among other customers. I wondered how the staff here operates.

The male dentist was attentive, calm, and only performed the teeth cleaning. I mentioned I had also booked the teeth polishing package. He said the counter only wrote down the order for cleaning, but he polished my teeth as requested. I was dissatisfied that the branch administration didn't coordinate the customer's promotional offer.

Afterward, I went to the counter to settle the bill/documents. The staff reviewed the documents as usual. I then realized I had left my ID card at the counter upon arrival. I felt uneasy about this, but thought it was okay (other clinics return ID cards promptly after requesting them). When I received my ID card back, it wasn't in a plastic envelope until I asked for it. Even when submitting the reimbursement documents, there was no proper envelope provided; I had to ask for it again. Honestly, I feel tired just thinking about it. The counter staff seemed distracted and lacked concentration.

Compared to other clinics in the area, the service is definitely not up to par. I should have gone to the clinic next door instead.

This was my first visit, on April 16th, 2026 at 2 PM.
